tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /yang ri 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i bca' yig thar pa'i lam ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/ /dregs ldan yongs kyi ral pa'i ri mthon rtser/
༄༅/ /yang ri 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i bca' yig thar pa'i lam ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/ /dregs ldan yongs kyi ral pa'i ri mthon rtser/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// yang ri 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i bca' yig thar pa'i lam ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti// dregs ldan yongs kyi ral pa'i ri mthon rtser// zhabs sen 'od stong 'bar ba rab 'khod cing*// 'gro blo'i rmongs mun drung nas 'byin mdzad pa// smra ba'i nyi ma thub dbang la phyag 'tshal// 'phags mchog klu zhabs slar yang gangs can 'dir// 'khrul blos thub bstan 'khyog por 'dren rnams kyi// lta ngan gzhom nas yang dag lam ston la// mgon po 'bri gung par grags de la 'dud// de la yang rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che de nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i grwa rigs 'bri gung par khas 'che ba spyi dang*/ bye brag yang ri sgar pa rtsa ba dang yan lag sgrub sde khag so so dang bcas pa'i 'dus pa rgya mtsho rnams kyi snyan gyi dbang por gsol ba skabs su bab pa| mkhos su pheb pa/ thugs nyams su nges par bzhes dgos pa 'di skad ces gleng ba ste/ rang re rnams 'di ltar bsam zhing nyams su blang bar rigs te/ thob par dka' ba dal ba brgyad 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa mi'i lus rten skyon med pa ni legs par thob/ mjal dka' ba spyir bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa dang*/ khyad par rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po zhes pa 'phags mchog klu sgrub nyid gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir lta sgom spyod pa sna tshogs su spyod cing rtog ge 'khrul pa can rnams kyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi don ma rtogs shing log par rtog pa dang*/ gzhan khyad du gsod pa'i sems kyis phyin ci log tu bkral ba rnams gzhom zhing*/ skal ldan rnams tshe gcig gis rdzogs byang thob pa'i gdams pa rnams legs par ston pa'i bstan pa'i snying po dam pa 'di lta bu dang ni mjal/ rjes su 'dzin par dka' ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis rjes su legs par bzung*/ rnyed par dka' ba rang nyid kyi nyams len gyis lcog na tshe gcig gis rdzogs byang thob pa/

dam pa'i chos sdom pa gsum gnad gcig tu ston pa 'di rnams dang phrad pa'i tshe/ dam pa'i chos dri ma med par sha stag brtson pa chen pos nyams su blang ba'i dus la bab pa yin no// de yang tshul ji ltar nyams su blang zhe na/ thog mar grwa tshang 'di la sogs par 'jug pa'i gsar bu pa rnams brtag ste/ rten mdzes pa'i bar chad dang*/ skye ba'i bar chad sogs dang mi ldan pa kho na la 'jug /de yang nang pa'i sgor tshud pa'i thabs skyabs 'gro gzhir bzhag /de'i bslab bya thun mong ma yin pa gsum/ thun mong ba skyes bu dam pa bsten pa sogs brgyad la bslab/ de'i steng dge bsnyen yongs rdzogs kyi sdom pa blangs nas de'i bslab bya/ rtsa ba bzhi yan lag dngos gcig dang phyogs mthun mi dge ba lhag ma gsum rnams spong*/ de'i steng bar ma rab byung blangs te/ de'i bslab bya khyim pa dang phyi rol pa'i rtags spong ba/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags blang ba/ mkhan por gsol ba gdab pa ma nyams pa rnams bsrung*/ de'i steng du dge tshul gyi sdom pa blangs te de'i bslab bya pham pa dang 'dra ba'i nyes byas bzhi/ bshags bya'i nyes byas drug rnams bsrung*/ de nas lo nyi shu'am bcu dgu lon nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por bsgrubs nas de'i bslab bya ltung ba sde lngar grags pa/ pham pa bzhi/ lhag ma bcu gsum/ ltung byed kyi sde tshan las spang ltung sum cu dang*/ 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu rnams sde tshan gcig dang*/ sor bshags bzhi/ nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis te/ khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum rnams bcas pa'i 'jog mtshams dang*/ phra rags kyi rnam dbye sad par bya zhing nyams su blang*/ gal te dus dbang gis skyabs sdom nas bzung*/ nyes byas lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi bar la nyams chag byung na spyi bshags tsam ma yin par chos 'dul ba rang gzhung bzhin so sor phyir bcos la 'bad pas sdom pa gsor 'jug pa gal che/

de'i steng rang re'i rgyud pa 'di la byang chub kyi sems mchog tu bsngags pa yin pas dbu sems gang rung gi sems bskyed lta bu dang*/ khyad par rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam par thar pa bgrang ba las 'das kyang*/ tshan grangs su bcad pa la lar ngo mtshar can gyi gtam sum cu so bdun yod pa'i nang tshan/ thugs bskyed chen mo legs par mnos te/ de'i bslab bya phra rags la chag nyams byung na thun khongs ma 'das par 'chos so// de'i steng du tshe gcig gis byang chub thob par gsang sngags med ka med yin zhing*/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos kyang phyi 'dul ba la nang gsang sngags zhes gsungs pas sngags kyi theg pa la 'jug pa gal che bas/ sngags bla med kyi dkyil 'khor chen po gang yang rung bar dbang mnos te/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams mig ltar bsrung*/ nyams na phyir bcos gzhung ltar 'bad de bya/ dbang mnos nas de'i bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim la bslab ste/ mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi nyams len ni/ mgon po phag mo gru pa dang rje 'jig rten gsum mgon yab sras kyi dgongs pa ltar phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams khrid gnad du smin pa thob blo tsam ma yin pa rang rgyud la 'byongs nges pa re khrid thog de ka nas byung ba shin tu gal che/ de rjes sgrub brgyud 'di mos gus kyi lam yin pas mos gus srog 'khor dang*/ chos drug /bar do dmar khrid rnams cis kyang gal che/ de rjes rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa ratna'i mtshan can de nyid spyir 'bri bstan/ sgos yang ri sgar pa 'di la bka' drin zla bral yin pas yang zab dang rlung khrid kyang yang zab kyi cha lag yin pa dang*/ yid bzhin nor mchog la rtsal du ma bton na chos lta zhog /'jig rten phal pa'i khrel gzhung dang yang mi mthun pas de nyid la nyams len 'bur du dod pa byed/ de 'og gang la gang mos kyi nyams len zhu bar 'bad 'bung 'don|

de ltar nyams su blang bya'i chos mnos pa rnams nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ni/ mtshams grwa dang ri phug la 'khod pa rnams ni/ nyams len la dus 'da' ba zhig dgos la/ spro lung sogs la bzhugs pa rnams kyis kyang nyin zhag phrugs gcig don med du ma song ba nyams len la brtson na/ thor thun gyi 'khar rnga brdung phral tshad med pa'i lha mo bzhi'i zhu ba'i glus bskul bar mos te/ gnyid sad nas nyal stabs sogs ma yin par lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga'am bdun dang ldan pas 'gyur sngags kyi rim pa dang*/ dbyangs gsal ye dhar sogs ci 'grub bzlas rjes dgongs pa yang zab kyi sngon 'gro 'don sgom sbrag pa rang rgyud la 'dre nges par byas nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gzhan slar 'don sgom mi dgos| gnad shes na lnga ldan yang 'di nyid la tshang ba yin/ de rjes yid bzhin nor mchog gi gsol 'debs dang*/ gzhan yang gsol 'debs gang 'os mthar lus sbyong dang yi dam gzhan gyi mngon rtogs dang*/ 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i rim pa la sogs par 'bad/ nam langs nas nyi shar bar chos spyod gang rung gi rim pa dang*/ bza' btung gi snga rol dus su rung ba sogs skabs thob gang yod rnams spyod/ de 'phral sham thabs la sogs pa tshul dang mthun par bgos nas tshogs kyi gtor brda byung 'phral thams cad 'tshogs nas nor lha brul gtor dang brgya rtsa sogs gtor chog rnams rnam 'dren sbyin pa'i shing rta ltar legs par 'don/ de nas dgong thun gyi bar du sgyu lus 'pho ba bar do sogs sbyong ba dang*/ bzlas brjod gsung rab klog pa dang dpe ltas phyag skor bya ba/ gsar bu rnams yi ge 'bri zhing klog pa dang chos spyod slob pa sogs tshul dang mthun zhing don ldan gyi bya ba la 'bad/ dgong thun la'ang mi rtag pa gtso bor sgom zhing gsol 'debs chos spyod gang 'os byas rjes/ mgon khang pas gtor brda byung 'phral/

nang gtor 'bul gtor bsngo ba'i rim pa rgyas pa dang*| bskang bshags bstod pa mnga' gsol byas rjes/ srod la thun tshod pas rkang gling byung bstun thams cad kyis rkang gling legs par bus nas lus sbyin ku sā la'i tshogs gsog legs par byas rjes/ grol brda ma byung bar chos spyod gang 'thad dang srung 'khor zhal gdams ma dang*/ yi ge gsum gyi srung 'khor ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blang ba dang smon lam gang 'grub kha ton byas mthar grol brda byung 'phral/ bzlas brjod dang chos spyod 'phro lus yod na gzhan gyis ma thos par shub bus bya zhing*/ de las gzhan pa'i gtam tshig sogs mtha' dag spangs nas/ 'phags pa'i mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la gnas pas nyal zhing gtum mo'i nyams len la 'bad/ nam gung la bde bar gnyid cing*/ thum phrad kyi snang ba dang*/ rmi lam sbyang spel sprul sgyur sogs la 'bad/ dus kun tu 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug bza' btung gi dus sogs bya byed gang byed kyang sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du bya snyam pa'i ngang nas lus yi dam du bsgoms pa'i spyi bor bla ma bsgom/ bya ba gang byed de'i ngo bor sems las ma 'das pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i ngang las ma g.yos par bya/ mthar de thams cad sems can gyi don du bsngos pas tshe 'di'i bya bzhag gang byas lnga ldan gyi nyams len las ma 'das shing chos ldan du 'gro ba gnad zab pa yin/ bla gnyer/ grwa mang*/ ja ma/ lag bde sogs thams cad kyis rang rang 'dug sa'i gnas khang la 'dzin spras gad brdar thigs tshags sogs la 'bad cing*/ thams cad kyis 'du khang gi gces spras la hur thum 'bad rtsol byed pa gal che/ phyi sgo yan la rta nor gtan nas mi 'ded/ grwa shag so so'i thog steng dang*/ sgo 'gag dang rdo gcal steng sogs su rtswa sogs me shing brtsegs pa dang*/ lci ba thang du 'ding ba sogs lar mi byed/ rtsa mkhar phyin spro lung nang yan chad kyi ri klung thams cad kyi shing che phra kun srung ba ma gtogs/

rang gzhan sus kyang gcod 'breg gtan nas mi byed/ tshogs kyi kun spyod la dung khang nas dung brda byung 'phral du dung mkhan gnyis kyi dung thengs gsum btang ba'i tha ma'i dus dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa dgos/ de yang chos gos gding ba rnams phrag la bkal/ 'du khang sgo 'gag nas kha bshal/ 'du khang nang logs su mchil lham phud nas sgo'i nang logs su 'jog pa ma gtogs rang sdod sar lham khyer nas rgyab 'og tu 'jug pa sogs gtan nas mi byed/ gtso cher bslab gral la gdong gral du 'don spyod gdangs dbyangs 'dzom zhing skad legs pa rnams sdod/ de'i rgyab gral gzhan du bslab gral ma gtogs nga che nga gnyan ham pa gang che mi byed/ tshogs su rgan gzhon thams cad gding ba med pa dang dge tshul yan chad rnams chos gos med pa mi byed/ 'tshogs 'phral dge skos kyis nyul nas/ gong 'og spo dgos dang gral khyag khyog dang ya yo 'bar 'bur med pa thad drang du 'chos/ dung thebs tha ma'i mjug tu dbu mdzad kyis chos spyod 'go 'dzugs par byed| thams cad chos spyod dbu mdzad la bstun pa'i gral gang 'grig ma gtogs/ la las ngan 'khyer dang mi 'don pa sogs gtan nas mi byed/ gdan bzhes sogs yod na thams cad kyis lhung bzed khyer/ lhung bzed med pa dang phyi dro yin na rtsam pa ras khug tu bzed/ snga dro yin na tshogs gral du zhib khu btung ba ma gtogs/ dkor skal bzed nas pho rog sha khyer gyis mi 'gro/ sha la dus mchod yin na cho ga de nyid kyi tshogs byin rlabs ltar dang dus mchod min na bde mchog ltar dang*/ nam yang byin rlabs ma byas par longs mi spyod/ phyi dro yin na lag bde rnams kyis mang ja'i snod gral med sa la bzhag nas rung chu 'debs/ chos spyod kyang sbyin bdag 'dod gsol yod na ma gtogs chos spyod gsar rnying 'don res las gcig 'don gcig bzhag mi byed/ gral du chos gos dang gzan kha g.yol byas nas mi sdod/

tshogs rgyun thung na chos spyod mi 'gro sbyin bdag blo kha mi rdzogs shing rang nyid kyi dkor mi 'byang bas tshogs rgyun ring nges shes pa rang byed/ grol khar chab btang ba zhal ba sogs gang bder mi 'pho/ gding ba'i kha brag gam gzan gos kyi nang du dor/ bsngo ba grub nas dal gyis langs nas chos gos bltab pa phrag la bkal ba'i steng du gding lhung bkal/ mar lam sgo nang nas mchil lham gyon nas dal bus grol dgos pa yin/ dus rgyun du gung tshigs yol nas rung khang du mang ja snod du blugs par bzhag /rung chu btab nas so sor 'dren/ dus mchod tshes gsum la mi 'khrugs pa dang*/ bsang rgyags rngan/ a phyi'i lhug gsol/ rgyal gsol/ tshes brgyad la mtshan brjod/ bcu la dgongs pa yang zab bskang ba dang sbrags pa/ bcu gsum la zhi khro/ bco lnga la bsang rgyags rngan dang*/ lhug gsol/ rgyal gsol/ nyer bdun la bde mchog rgyas pa/ nyer dgu la bskang gsol shes pa rnams kyis dgu gtor mnga' gsol rgyas pa sogs/ gnam gang la bde mchog rgyas pa rnams chag med dang*/ tshes dgu la bka' brgyad dang*/ nyer lnga la drag po sngar gtong srol yod pas grub na legs/ gshin don gyi chog mang dang dgung zhag sogs la bde mchog tshar re re'i mthar zhi khro rgyas pa dang*/ phung po yod na lho sgo dang*/ byang bu rus bu dum bu sogs la rigs drug gnas 'dren ma chag par dgos pa sogs ni nyams su blang bya 'jug pa'i rim pa yin la/ spang bya ldog pa'i rim pa ni/ rgan gzhon gsar rnying thams cad kyis dor ma/ phu dung dang*/ smad g.yogs dang*/ stod g.yogs dang*/ stod 'gag gi nang dkar po/ thul pa/ ko gdan/ stod 'gag gi nang du rngul len/ stod 'gag gi steng du dar mgul phyag mdud gyon pa/ sham thabs kyi phyi rol du phor shub/ a cor/ snag smyug /glo gri/ 'bug dang*/ sgo ru sogs 'dog pa/ skra dang kha spu ring por 'jog pa/ gzan ma gyon par 'gro ba/

sham thabs ma bgos par brang khang dang cog pu'i sgor don pa/ tshogs gral du thang khug dang*/ khams phor 'khyer ba/ bem po dang zha thul sogs tshogs su gyon pa/ rked par gri mdzub gang las ring ba 'jug pa/ nyin mo sgom thag dang ras rkyang gyon pa/ sho dang mig mang rgyal blon dgu 'grig rdo sgor sogs rtse ba/ sbe kha gnya' tshan brang 'dul rgyug 'chong gzhan gyi bro shon rtsed 'jo lha 'dre bab pa sogs la blta ba/ sgrung rgyud dang*/ glu len pa/ pho 'khyud dang lag sbrel gyis 'gro ba/ sdod sar rkang pa rkyong ba/ dbyar zhing khar 'gro zhing lgang srubs 'thog pa/ spyi pa'i las ka yod na ma gtogs/ rang don la gnang ba ma zhus par tshogs mi 'tshogs par grong gseb du 'gro ba/ skar ma gdol pa shar dus ma gtogs chu la rtse ba/ tshogs 'tshogs pa dang grol dus 'tshang kha rgyag pa dang bre mo'i gtam smra ba/ tshogs gral du shub bus lab pa sham thabs dang chos gos phyi nang slog nas gyon pa/ lhung bzed rdo rje dril bu sa rjen la 'jog pa/ zhwa mo kha dog dang bzo bcos sna tshogs gyon pa/ brang khang nang du ma gtogs par 'du 'tshogs dang pho khrom ga zha dang*/ bzhad gad 'thus zas ku co rgyang 'bod/ 'ur kha rdo rgyang 'phen pa/ khyi la rdo rgyag pa/ mi ser gyi khrod du shed ngom/ sgo rdung khyi dkrog /mo pra mdos chog /lam 'grul ba dang*/ tshong pa dang*/ gnas skor ba dang*/ sprang po la sogs pa'i rtsar rang gzhan gyi zhe 'dod phyogs ris su chad pa'i gtam yin min sna tshogs su smra ba/ bla ma dang grwa pa'i bar dang*/ grogs mched kyi bar sogs la snying gtam la bsnyad btags pa'i rdzun kha phra ma dbyen mchu skyel ba/ rgyab lang ngan sgrig mi dpung gra sdebs byed pa/ spyi sger sus kyang mgron po dang nye ring la khag bsnyad pa'i bud med kyi rigs rgyal sgo yan la zhag sdod byed du 'jug pa/ tshogs pa'i nang du bsten pa'i gsang dbang rdzas dang tshogs chang sogs khyor bzed ma gtogs phor pa bzed pa/

brang khang so sor gung tshigs yol nas thug pa bkol ba/ grong du khyim grogs med par rgyu ba brang khang rnams su don med du nyul ba/ gang du'ang chab ma blangs par 'bag langs byed pa/ tshogs gral du phor pa sgra bcas su 'jog pa/ phor pa lces ldag pa/ bza' btung gang yang sgra dang bcas pa/ lag pa ldag pa sogs gtan nas byed sa med/ grwa tshang 'di spyi thab tu song bas grangs tshan mang nyung gang yang shi gson gyi don du phyin par/ 'bul chas che chung gang byung yang gtsang ma spyi sar sprod pa ma gtogs rang rang 'dzin sa med pa sngar srol yin/ byes 'gro phran bu byed na rta dang khal la sogs pa la hab thob byed pa dang*/ sho lam du sham thabs ma bcings pa dang*/ gzan med rjen hrang du 'gro ba dang*/ thab rdo me shing mi skyel ba sogs dang*/ mdor na bla ma dang chos khrims phyag mdzod pa'i ngag bkod du 'gal ba dang*/ grong pa'i gzan shing la lag rgyag pa dang*/ dbyar zhing thog tu khal ma 'ded pa sogs gtan nas byed sa med/ de ltar spang bya ldog pa'i rim pa rnams thos shing shes nas/ bcas phra rags gang la 'gal yang phyir bcos chad las kyi rim pa ni/ dor ma nas bzung lag pa ldag pa yan chad phra mo rnams la 'gal ba byung na/ lan re tsam 'gal ba la dge skos kyis ngag gi bslab bya kha ta lkog tu gtad/ des ma nyan na tshogs gral du dmigs phug nas lab/ des kyang ma nyan par 'gal na gos dkar po sogs mi 'os pa rnams blangs la tshogs gdan dang rdog phyis bya/ phor thang sogs gral mdor gcog cing gshag /gzhan rnams gang byung yang brgya phyag 'buladu gzhug /brang khang du kha 'thab tshig rtsod tsam byas par/ der yod gzhan rnams kyis gnyis kar lab btang*/ des kha rog ma bsdad na bla ma chos khrims gnyer chen rnams la ja zhus dang 'brang ja/ brang khang du lag thug byas pa byung na zla bo rnams kyis bar bya zhing*/ mang ja brgya phyag gi steng bla mar bdun tshan dang*/ dge skos dang gnyer par man tsi kha re/

brang khang gi phyir kha 'thab dang lag 'dzing byas pa la gong ma la nyis ldab/ gri bton pa byung na mang ja brgya phyag /bla mar dgu tshan/ dge skos dang gnyer par sum tshan re/ rdo dbyug sbar mo sogs kyis khrag bton pa byung na mang ja brgya phyag dung dar/ snyan dar/ bla mar dgu tshan/ chos khrims dang gnyer par lnga tshan re/ chang dri bro ba 'thung ba byung na khrag bton pa dang khyad med pa'i chad 'gel/ rnam pa kun tu chang bag med btung na mang ja brgya phyag snyan dar dung dar bla mar sham thabs gtsos pa'i dgu tshan/ chos khrims dang gnyer par lnga tshan re/ spyi chos la ja mog khag re yis gtsos pa'i lnga tshan re/ de mi bsgrub zer na gnas dbyung bya/ pham pa bzhi gang rung spyad zer ba'i lab brjod byung na/ kho rang la rtsad bcad nas min nges zer na mgon khang du mna' 'bul/ yin par khas blang na bla mar dngos po spus gtsang bcu gsum tshan/ gnyer chos la bdun tshan snyan dar/ dung dar mang ja sbyor sbrel dang*/ phyag sum brgya 'bul ba'i rjes grwa sar sdod na sdom ro phul nas bslab bskyar tshad ldan dang*| mi sdod na gar 'gror btang*/ pham pa bzhi dngos su spyad pa bsnyon med la kho rang gi dngos po spyi ru bzhes te gnas dbyung gtsang mar bya/ gnyer chos khrims la kha len bslogs pa byung na/ mang ja dang brgya phyag dang stong phyag /lag bslogs pa byung na kho rang gi chas ka rnams bskur te zhi bas gnas dbyung bya/ gal srid bla mar kha len bslogs na/ kho rang gi dngos po thams cad spyi pas blangs te gnas dbyung dang*/ kho rang gi dngos po ma lus pa mang jar bsgril nas mdo sgrub ci mang dang*/ dgu gtor gyi dus thun gtor 'phangs nas rtsa ba chod pa zhig byed dgos/ phyag mdzod sogs las 'dzin che phra thams cad kyis kyang las ka la bsnyad btags pa'i tshul 'chal/ bag yang*/ ma rabs kyi spyod pa gzan sham dang bral ba/ bu chung hor 'dra ltar 'gro nyal de mdo de med kyi spyi thebs med pa/

grwa pa rnams la nye ring dang phyogs skyong sogs gtan nas mi byed/ dbu mdzad kyis 'don pa smar ba dang*/ bsam pa che zhing rtag par tshogs 'tshogs shing mig ltos la phan pa byed dgos/ dge skos kyis kyang zla re bzhin bca' yig chag med du sgrog pa dang*/ khrims 'gal mig la gnod pa rnams la mdo sgrub tshar gsum re rgyab pa dang*/ thun skor ba sogs khrims kyi bya ba la nan tan byed dgos/ tshogs su'ang rnam pa kun tu yar gyu nas bsdad pa kho nas mi 'ong bas| phal che bar langs nas gral rnams la ldog 'jug byed pa sogs nan tan byed dgos/ bla ma la yang thugs brel che na ma gtogs tshogs dbur 'byon rtag pa dang*/ thams cad la bkod pas khyab pa sogs byed pa gal che/ de ltar la phyag mdzod kyis 'gal na phyag sum brgya re/ dge skos kyis 'gal na phyag stong phrag re 'bul dgos pa bca' yig rnying pa ltar yin/ grwa pa rnams kyi khrod nas tshe 'di blos btang gis tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa byed nges byung na ma gtogs/ grwa tshang gi sgrig dang bzang po'i kun spyod ma nus shing*/ lto skor gnas skor la sogs spyod pa bag yang khyi sprang ltar 'khyams shing rtogs ldan yin zer ba'i ya spyod tho col bstan bshig rnams la 'dren pa/ kha mig mthur lta byas na bdud kyi bar chad yin pas der ma song bar bya/ rtsa ba mdor dril ba/ mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po'i bca' yig tu/ bslab bya 'di rnams mi sgrub pa'i dregs pa can/ rang blo 'khrul ba la tshad mar bzung nas 'di 'dra ba sus thub zer ba'i sdig to can 'ga' dang*/ grwa sar slebs snga la yon tan med pa'i rgan yus dang chos dred rdzi rgan gyi tshod yod 'dzin pa/ skyid na sdod/ sdug na 'gro bsam pa/ skyid sdug med pa'i nyon mongs mgo yan gyi spyod pa tshul ma yin pa byed pa/ khrel ngo tsha dang bral ba rnams so sor rang gang 'dod kyi gnas su 'gro bar gyis/

de ltar ma yin pa'i bdag la tshad mar 'dzin cing chos tshul bzhin byed pa rnams kyis bslab bya 'di rnams la nan tan byed pa gal che'o// zhes gsungs pa rnams rgyu mtshan du byas te/ thams cad kyis tshul de ltar thugs kyi dkyil snying khong rus pa'i gting du 'jog pa ci nas kyang gal che/ de thams cad kyi spyi sdom du dus mchod nam yin gyi dgong mo tshogs grol khar sher snying tshar rer bdud zlog sbyar ba thengs gsum re byed pa'i tshar dang po grwa tshang spyi'i rim gro/ gnyis pa bcas 'gal mig ltos la gnod pa gang byas rnams la dmigs/ gsum pa chang dri bro ba tsam 'thung ba yan chad chang kho na'i rjes gcod la dmigs pa yin pas/ 'di do dam du bla ma chos khrims pa dbu mdzad gsum gyis rtsag rtsol 'bad 'bung ma chag par byed pa gal shin tu che ba yin no// gang zhig srid zhi'i rgud pa kun 'joms shing*/ dgos 'dod tshogs 'phel thub bstan 'bar ba'i snod// 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i bca' khrims brjed tho'i ngag /yi ger spel 'di bstan pa'i byi dor yin// bstan rtsa dge 'dun sde yang bslab pa la// nan tan srung ba kho na la ltos pas// rgyal gsung dri ma med pa'i tshul soms la// kun gyis 'di la nyams su blang byar mdzod// kho bos rang 'dod rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang*// bca' yig snga ma'i don dang mi mthun pa// nye ring phyogs su chad pa yin nam min// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis dpang po mdzod// 'di dges dge 'dun mthun zhing bslab la brtson// thos bsam sgom pa'i bya bas dus 'da' zhing*// sgrub brgyud bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// sems can thams cad bde ba'i gnas thob shog /ces pa 'di yang sgar pa che chung spro lung du zla bsgril gdan la phab pa'i bca' yig tu/ bca' yig snga ma gnyis gzhir byas shing*/ slar ma 'thus pa zhib mor bris pa 'di'ang 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung las/
